# Safety-complete model card fixture (Phase 14)

## Misuse and Malicious Use

Do not use this model to generate scams, phishing content, or other dual-use abuse.
Out-of-scope harms include social-engineering assistants and automated fraud tools.

## Privacy

This model does not intentionally store PII. Personal data should be redacted before
inference. GDPR and data-protection reviews are recommended for enterprise use.

## Security Considerations

Do not deploy without adversarial testing. Known vulnerability notes include prompt
injection and data-exfiltration via long-context attacks.

## Training Data

Training data sources are public review corpora with documented collection process and
data license terms for reproducibility.

## Human Oversight

Human review is required before any high-stakes decision that uses model outputs.
